name: Salman Rahman
headline: SQL Server & Database Engineer | T-SQL, Query Optimization & ERP Data Systems | C# (.NET) · Power BI · Python
short_bio: SQL Server & ERP Database professional specializing in Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL optimization, multi-outlet Web POS reconciliation, Crystal Reports, and enterprise software in C# (.NET) and Python.
summary: Database and Enterprise Systems professional with a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering (Varendra University) and a Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science (UIU, CGPA 3.56), specializing in Microsoft SQL Server engineering, T-SQL development, and operational reporting.

At HATIM GROUP (Executive, IT & MIS), manages and optimizes Microsoft SQL Server databases supporting the central InteAcc ERP and retail Web POS network—writing and tuning T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and indexing strategies while maintaining backups, integrity checks, and transaction reconciliation.

Previously served as Junior Software Engineer at Logic InfoTech Ltd building enterprise application modules in C# (.NET Framework) with SQL Server and MySQL backends alongside Crystal Reports, complemented by Power BI (DAX) and Python data workflows.

problem_solving_approach.description: Designing normalized relational schemas, explicit constraints, and deterministic audit trails in Microsoft SQL Server.
Transforming complex operational and transactional tables into clear, dependable Crystal Reports, Power BI models, and analytical SQL datasets.
Building maintainable ERP workflows, APIs, and operational tooling with C# (.NET) and Python (FastAPI).
Applying Google IT Support certified diagnostics across workstations, ODBC connectivity, backups, and enterprise infrastructure.

banner.badge_text: OPEN TO SQL, DATABASE & ERP BACKEND ROLES
banner.tagline: Designing resilient SQL Server architectures, enterprise ERP workflows, and actionable reporting systems.
